fee_details:

- Less than Rs.1,00,000: Nil
- Rs.1,00,000 to Rs.5,00,000: Rs.500
- Rs.5,00,000 to Rs.10,00,000: Rs.1,000

joining_perks:
- Bonus Snapdeal vouchers worth Rs.2,000 as welcome gift.
- Get 500 reward points as a welcome gift with this credit card.
reward_structure:
- You will receive 2 reward points every time you spend Rs.150 with the Snapdeal HDFC Bank Credit Card.
- 10X reward points (20 reward points/ Rs.150) when you spend on Snapdeal. Please visit the website to know more about this benefit.
key_highlights:
- Get a 5% discount on all purchases you make on Snapdeal with this credit card.
- Your fuel surcharge of 2.5% will be replaced with a convenience fee of 1%.

benefits_features.Snapdeal Benefits: Get a 5% discount on purchases that you make through Snapdeal.
benefits_features.Reward Benefits: You will receive 2 reward points every time you spend Rs.150 with the Snapdeal HDFC Bank Credit Card.
benefits_features.Fuel Benefits: Your fuel surcharge of 2.5% will be replaced with a convenience fee of 1%.

how_tos.How can I use the HDFC reward points ear: You should log on to your HDFC credit card banking account and then request for the promo codes for Snapdeal. You can choose from many snapdeal codes for reward points amounting to Rs.500, Rs.1,000 and Rs.1,500.
how_tos.How can I track the status of my card?: Visit our credit card section on the bank website. After you type in all your details like the application form number, application reference number, date of birth, and mobile number, you will be able to view the progress of your application.
how_tos.How can I use the Snapdeal gift voucher?: You can visit the Snapdeal website and select the items that you want to purchase. After you are taken to the payment page, click on "Gift Voucher." Type in your 16-digit number and then the PIN and then "Apply."
